title: Janus v2.1.0 — Phone Media Browsing, Auto-Start & Auto-Connect Optimization
notes: Complete Phone Media Browsing: Browse, preview, and download photos, videos, and documents directly from Mac
Auto-Start: Android starts on boot (BootReceiver), Mac launches at login (tauri-plugin-autostart)
Auto-Connect Optimization: Accelerated 1s reconnect + dynamic mDNS rediscovery on network change
Zero-touch background reconnect when switching between Wi-Fi and Hotspot
